020.title: The app loads and answers fast: small icon font, compressed and cached files, fewer database trips
humanItems: In a browser window that never opened the app, the home screen shows its icons as icons right away.
An entry saved on one phone appears on the other phone within about 15 seconds without touching it.
In Settings → icons the picker shows every icon; an icon picked there shows on the home screen, also after a reload.
The installed app icon on the phone looks the same as before.

decisions.text: behaviour: the session memory is per repository instance and the catalog memory is per catalog context, each with a registry that clearCatalogMemory() and clearCache() empty (the plan said a module-level map). A single shared map would break the existing tests that wipe the database between tests — reverse: make the Map module-level and call clearCatalogMemory() in those test h

behaviour: the two existing auth tests that edit session rows directly now read the changed row through a fresh app, because the 60 s session memory would otherwise hide the edit — reverse: drop the session memory.
behaviour: the sync route takes only `limit`, not `from` or `to`, as the plan says — reverse: add parseBound to the route.
behaviour: icon.ts now asks for the full font for any icon name that is not in app-icon-names.ts, not only for overrides — reverse: limit the check to the slot override branch.

behaviour: the two app icons are palette PNGs (16 colours, no dithering) made with sharp-cli; the 512 px file is 59491 bytes, just under the 60 kB budget — reverse: restore the original PNGs from git.
